description: Full re-run with 4 code changes vs v121: (1) separate BASELINE_PROMPT without masking/reasoning suppression, (2) triggered_guardrails multi-trigger field, (3) G5 fail-closed with downstream guardrail pass-through, (4) baseline_failure_modes analytical G1/G2/G4 annotation on baseline output.

code_changes_vs_v121.baseline_prompt: BASELINE_PROMPT created: no MASKED instruction, reasoning field allowed — measures unguarded LLM leakage for G3 value quantification
code_changes_vs_v121.multi_trigger: triggered_guardrails field added to apply_guardrails_with_routing() and serialized in results — captures all guardrails that fired per sample
code_changes_vs_v121.g5_passthrough: G5 fail-closed routing preserved, but downstream G2/G4/G1/G3 now execute on parsed_output or {} for failure-mode annotation
code_changes_vs_v121.baseline_failure_modes: G1/G2/G4 validators run analytically on baseline output (annotation only, no routing) — enables before/after failure-mode comparison

guardrails.g5_behavior: fail-closed with downstream pass-through for annotation
